Actually retrosynthetic: target -> precursors. So precursors are "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" and "Nc1ccccc1N". Good.

Now need to apply next template 1914396 to each appropriate fragment? The route must have at least 3 reactions using templates in order: 324324, then 1914396, then 733.

We need to construct a tree where first reaction uses template 324324, children are two molecules. Then for each of those, we need further reactions using next templates. Probably apply 1914396 to first fragment (the sulfonyl phenyl with a carboxylic acid?) and maybe also to second fragment (an aniline). Then final template 733 to break something further.

We need to check applicability.

First fragment: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1". Let's test template 1914396 on it.
